title: Content Pillars
summary: Three clear pillars eliminate daily guessing — every idea connects to one pillar.

sections.heading: Orientation
sections.subtitle: Introduction to the Lesson
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What will you understand?** When you define your **Content Pillars**, it makes **publishing decisions** easier and faster.
- **Goal:** To build **3 clear pillars** that you can rely on.
- **What comes after the lesson?** You will have a **content map** instead of daily confusion about "What should I post?".
bullets: **What will you understand?** When you define your **Content Pillars**, it makes **publishing decisions** easier and faster.
**Goal:** To build **3 clear pillars** that you can rely on.
**What comes after the lesson?** You will have a **content map** instead of daily confusion about "What should I post?".

sections.heading: Tension
sections.subtitle: Common Problem
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Daily question:** "What should I post?"
- **Without pillars:** Ideas seem **random** and overwhelming.
- Even with **good work**, your **presence** remains weak if the message is not **coherent**.
bullets: Even with **good work**, your **presence** remains weak if the message is not **coherent**.

sections.heading: Core Idea
sections.subtitle: 3 Pillars Are Enough
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Content Pillar:** A main **fixed** topic — every **content idea** should follow **one of them**.
- **3 pillars** are more than enough — you don't need a long list.
- **AI (artificial intelligence)** can suggest **ideas** under each pillar — but the **choice** of what serves your **audience** and **goals** remains **yours**.
bullets: **Content Pillar:** A main **fixed** topic — every **content idea** should follow **one of them**.
**3 pillars** are more than enough — you don't need a long list.
**AI (artificial intelligence)** can suggest **ideas** under each pillar — but the **choice** of what serves your **audience** and **goals** remains **yours**.

sections.heading: Comparison
sections.subtitle: Random Variety or Clear Pillars?
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Without Pillars | With Pillars |
|----------------|--------------|
| Ideas are **disconnected** — and the message is **unclear** to the audience | Each idea serves a **coherent image** — followers know **what you stand for** |

sections.heading: Glossary
sections.subtitle: 3 Key Terms
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|------|---------|---------|
| **Content Pillar** | A main **fixed** topic from which a lot of content is derived | Education, Experiences, Tools |
| **Topic Idea** | A **small** idea related to a specific pillar | Under the Tools pillar: A tool that organizes **script writing** |
| **Content Mix** | **Distribution** of content among the pillars in a **balanced** way | One post from **each pillar** every week |

sections.heading: Quiz
sections.subtitle: Quick Confirmation
sections.contentMarkdown:
> **Quiz key (unchanged):** correctIndex: 1

**Question:** If you have **ten scattered topics** and don't know how to **establish your presence** — what is the **best first step**?

Post them **all equally**.
**Choose 3 main pillars** and distribute ideas **under them**.
Stop posting** for a whole month.**

**Explanation:** Limiting ideas to **3 pillars** creates **clarity** and **continuity** instead of **distraction**.
bullets: **Choose 3 main pillars** and distribute ideas **under them**.
Stop posting** for a whole month.**

sections.heading: Mission
sections.subtitle: 3 Pillars + 3 Ideas for Each Pillar
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Introduction:** The mission is **a training exercise** — **not a test**. Define **3 clear pillars** and write **3 practical ideas** for each pillar.

**Submission:** For each pillar (1–3): name + 3 related ideas.

**Evaluation Criteria:**

| Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| Clarity of Pillars | 50% | The pillars are **distinct and clear**; each pillar should be able to produce **ongoing content** |
| Quality of Ideas | 50% | **3 ideas** for each pillar are **clearly related** to it |
